newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil prisoners hold nine hostages.
newsitem.headline: Brazil prisoners hold nine hostages.

text.p: Nine people were being held hostage in a prison rebellion in the Brazilian town of Vitoria da Conquista, Bahia state, local Globo television said on Sunday.
The rebellion started on Saturday when 10 detainees took 10 prison officials and religious workers hostage. One prison official was later released after taking ill.
The prisoners demanded money, arms and cars, Globo said.
Prison and police officials could not be reached to confirm the report.
